recommended_primary: Acute-on-chronic kidney injury superimposed on diabetic nephropathy
review_summary: The original differential captured the chronic comorbidities but omitted the acute renal insult and did not explicitly link the markedly dilute urine to tubular dysfunction. Adjusted probabilities reflect a balanced view, adding acute‑on‑chronic kidney injury as a primary consideration. Several key investigations (CBC, UACR, cardiac echo, BNP, renal imaging) are missing, limiting definitive confirmation of several secondary diagnoses.
